analytical_question: Should this organization adopt, experiment, monitor, defer or reject GenAI client-summary drafting now?
general_et_finding: GenAI can produce fluent draft text; fluency is not verified factual accuracy. Actual maturity, market diffusion and vendor capabilities require dated verification.
application_finding: Drafting summaries may save writing time but requires source fidelity, human review, confidentiality and comparison with manual or rules-based drafting.
organization_specific_finding: A serious factual error escaped review; expansion is unjustified even if drafting speed improved.

evidence.claim: Scenario assumes GenAI produces plausible drafts but savings and error rates are unmeasured
evidence.notes: Not a market, vendor or performance fact

evidence.claim: Course requires context-sensitive, bounded adoption posture and contrast testing
evidence.notes: Methodological requirement, not evidence of GenAI performance

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Escaped material factual error demonstrates review failure.
No independent verification of current vendor retention terms, regulatory requirements, actual error rates or cost-benefit.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in conditional posture from stated hypothetical constraints; low confidence in technology/vendor-specific claims pending current verification.
value_opportunity_implication: Possible faster first drafts, contingent on measured end-to-end review-adjusted savings.
risk_governance_implication: Do not use confidential client data without written authorization, validated security controls and applicable legal review; require source checks and a stop rule.
recommendation_management_implication: BOUNDED EXPERIMENT (PAUSED AND NARROWED): Immediately halt client-facing output, investigate failure, redesign source-check and second review, rerun on synthetic/public cases only; resume bounded testing after agreed zero-critical-error gate in a sufficiently representative test set; do not claim zero risk. Decisive factor: Escaped material factual error demonstrates review failure.
change_monitoring_triggers: Verified vendor data governance and retention controls
Blinded source-grounded factual accuracy and severity testing
Measured net staff time including review versus manual baseline
Review in 30 days or immediately after any material error
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Incident root cause, severity, test-set adequacy and reviewer capacity are unknown.
